info.title: Citizen API
info.description: TRIGGER_CONTRACT v1. effect.hype is an absolute delta on the 0..1 scale and the result is clamped to 0..1. effect.talentCost is a relative delta: 0.12 multiplies companies.talent_cost by 1.12 and the result is floored at 0. At least one effect must be non-zero. Posting the same id replaces that trigger and reapplies the stack from each company's captured baseline; it does not stack a second copy. DELETE /api/triggers/{id} removes one trigger. DELETE /api/triggers clears every v1 trigger and restores hype and talent cost to the captured baselines. Input deltas are bounded (hype -1..1, talentCost -100..100, at most 4 decimal places) so the NUMERIC(12,2) talent column cannot overflow from a single field. A company inserted while triggers are already active keeps its own hype and talent cost until the next trigger create, replace, delete, or clear. talentMultiplier stays the 0.5.0 employee mean. talentCostFactor is the stacked ratio talentCost / baselines.talentCost, clamped once to [0.1, 3] and rounded to 4 decimal places. It is 1, and talentCostFactorClamped is false, when there is no trigger or the baseline is missing, 0, negative, or non-finite. talentCostFactorClamped is true only when the raw ratio fell outside that range. Stored talentCost and hype stay raw. effectiveMultiplier is round(talentMultiplier * talentCostFactor, 4). API burnRate is round(baseBurnRate * talentMultiplier * talentCostFactor), rounded once, with no tax. The client simulation uses the same product after baseBurnRate = round(2000 * (1 + taxRate * 0.4)). Trigger writes do not change stored companies.burn_rate or companies.cash. A null, blank, NaN, or Infinity skill counts as 0.5. An empty talentMix means talentMultiplier is 1; contributions sum to talentMultiplier only when the mix is non-empty. The Host header must be localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1] on the bound port; anything else is 403. A missing Host is 400 {"error":"Host required"}. More than one Host header is 400 {"error":"Duplicate host"}. A validation failure is 400 with error and an issues array. A method the route does not implement is 405 {"error":"Method not allowed","issues":[]}. Campaign turns (0.8.0): POST /api/campaigns creates a versioned GameState. POST /api/campaigns/{id}/turns atomically commits a TurnCommand (set_tax, advance_turn, apply_trigger, remove_trigger, clear_triggers) and appends a turn_commits ledger row in the same transaction; a failed commit leaves no partial advance. GET /api/campaigns/{id} reloads the last committed state. GET /api/companies cash and burnRate remain non-authoritative for the client sim. TurnCommand hire_employee appends an employee to campaign GameState, recomputes talentMultiplier / burn preview, and drains cash only on advance_turn. Civic feedback (0.8.2): GameState.civic.budgetHeadroom = clamp(1 - taxRate, 0, 1); civic.hypeBias = (budgetHeadroom - 0.75) * 0.2 folds into company.hype on set_tax (bias 0 at 25% tax). Does not change Slice 1 burn baselines. civic-infra shows budget headroom as a readout only.

200.description: Companies. baselines are the values captured before the first v1 trigger. talentMultiplier and talentMix come from employees and keep their 0.5.0 meaning. talentCostFactor is the stacked talent-cost ratio clamped once to [0.1, 3]. talentCostFactorClamped is true only when that raw ratio was outside the range. effectiveMultiplier is round(talentMultiplier * talentCostFactor, 4). baseBurnRate is the stored Slice 1 burn and includes no tax. burnRate is round(baseBurnRate * talentMultiplier * talentCostFactor), rounded once. Trigger create, replace, delete, and clear do not write companies.burn_rate or companies.cash.

issues.message: type must be one of: set_tax, advance_turn, apply_trigger, remove_trigger, clear_triggers

RejectedHost.description: The Host header is missing or repeated. A missing Host is 400 {"error":"Host required"}. More than one Host header is 400 {"error":"Duplicate host"}.

ForbiddenHost.description: The Host header is not localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1] on the bound port.

Effect.description: At least one of hype or talentCost must be non-zero. A field may be present and 0 when the other is non-zero.

hype.description: Absolute delta on the 0..1 hype scale. 0.1 raises hype by 10 points from the company baseline. Results are clamped to 0..1.

talentCost.description: Relative delta. 0.12 multiplies the company talent-cost baseline by 1.12. Results are floored at 0.

department.description: Canonical lowercase department. Null when the employee department is NULL or blank. Unknown names weigh 1.

weight.description: Department weight: tech 1.25, marketing 1.05, sales 0.95, otherwise 1.

contribution.description: This group's share of talentMultiplier (the employee-only multiplier), rounded to 4 decimal places. When talentMix is non-empty, the rounded shares sum to talentMultiplier. They do not sum to effectiveMultiplier.

Company.description: hype and talentCost are the stacked values when this row already has baselines. A NULL hype or talent_cost falls back to its baseline column, then to 0.3 or 4000. Numeric company fields are never null. talentMix.department is null only when the employee department is NULL or blank. talentCostFactorClamped is a boolean. A company created while v1 triggers are active is not rewritten until the next trigger create, replace, delete, or clear. There is no baselines.talentMultiplier. talentMultiplier keeps its 0.5.0 employee-only meaning and is not clamped. effect.talentCost changes the raw talentCost. The burn factor clamps that stacked ratio once to [0.1, 3] and does not change the stored talentCost or hype. Stored companies.burn_rate and companies.cash stay as written by the company row.

burnRate.description: Effective monthly burn, computed on read with no tax and rounded once: round(baseBurnRate * talentMultiplier * talentCostFactor). talentCostFactor is already clamped to [0.1, 3] and rounded to 4 decimal places. The client simulation applies tax only by setting its own baseBurnRate to round(2000 * (1 + taxRate * 0.4)), then uses this same product. Trigger writes do not update the stored burn. With both factors at 1 this stays the stored integer burn. A stored base of 0 stays 0. Otherwise this is finite and greater than 0. Always a finite number.

baseBurnRate.description: Stored companies.burn_rate, the Slice 1 burn before either factor. A NULL burn_rate is returned as 0, the column default. Always a finite number. Trigger writes do not change this column.

talentMultiplier.description: Employee-only mean of per-employee department weight times skill factor, rounded to 4 decimal places. Same meaning as 0.5.0. Exactly 1 when the company has no counted employees, which is also when talentMix is empty. A null, blank, NaN, or Infinity skill counts as 0.5 before the skill factor. Always a finite number.

talentCostFactor.description: Stacked talentCost / baselines.talentCost, clamped once to [0.1, 3] and then rounded to 4 decimal places. Exactly 1 when talent cost has not moved from the baseline, or when the baseline is missing, 0, negative, or non-finite. A raw ratio below 0.1, including a stacked talent cost of 0, becomes 0.1. A raw ratio above 3 becomes 3. The clamp is not applied per trigger, and it does not change stored talentCost. Always finite.

talentCostFactorClamped.description: True only when the raw stacked talentCost / baselines.talentCost fell outside [0.1, 3] and was clamped. False when the raw ratio is inside that range, including exactly 0.1 and 3, and when there is no trigger or the baseline is missing, 0, negative, or non-finite.

effectiveMultiplier.description: round(talentMultiplier * talentCostFactor, 4). burnRate does not multiply this rounded product again. It rounds baseBurnRate * talentMultiplier * talentCostFactor once. Always finite and >= 0.

talentMix.description: Department groups. An empty array means talentMultiplier is exactly 1. When the array is non-empty, rounded contributions sum to talentMultiplier, the employee-only multiplier. They do not sum to effectiveMultiplier.

hype.description: Stacked hype. A NULL hype column falls back to hype_baseline, then the column default 0.3. The response never sends null.

talentCost.description: Stacked talent cost in dollars, stored and returned raw. The burn clamp does not change this value. A result of 0 stays 0. A NULL talent_cost column falls back to talent_cost_baseline, then the column default 4000. The response never sends null.

state.description: Optional partial GameState seed (cash from this object, never from companies API)

id.description: Optional hire_employee id; engine assigns hire-{department}-{n} when omitted
